mechanism: Ciprofloxacin inhibits CYP3A4, which metabolizes deutetrabenazine, potentially increasing deutetrabenazine concentrations and adverse effects including QT prolongation.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine side effects (orthostatic hypotension, sedation, parkinsonism); consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged QT risk is concerning; monitor ECG if interaction cannot be avoided.
